no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no Advisory Committee meeting convened for this NDA as there were no issues that required discussion in an Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for AKYNZEO (netupitant/palonosetron, NDA205718). The Summary Review and Cross-Discipline Team Leader review both state no AC meeting was held, and the Office Director memo explains the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions and outside expertise was not necessary. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
